signal: Clearspeed raised a $60M Series D (total $110M) in mid-2025, partnered with Carahsoft for public sector, and was named fastest-growing company on Deloitte's 2025 Technology Fast 500.

email.body1:
Nate, saw Clearspeed closed its $60M Series D and just topped Deloitte's Fast 500 as fastest-growing company.

Hypergrowth like that usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Clearspeed off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nate, quick follow-up for Clearspeed.

Growing into new verticals like public sector, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Clearspeed needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nate, last bit of proof for Clearspeed.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Clearspeed's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nate, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise, and a hypergrowth stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Clearspeed either way.
